opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to create a business account and open a partner’s account using a stated $5 payment, expressly linking that payment to receiving $5 from the partner account. It then describes income from partner-linked X3 and X4 slots and insists that viewers maintain a minimum number of partners. The claimed returns escalate further: 20 team members or partners are said to produce 50,000–100,000 rupees. A Forsage page also displays profits, BUSD/BNB figures, and a personal-link control, reinforcing the recruitment-based structure. These are specific income claims tied to account creation and team building, although the available evidence does not establish that displayed balances were paid out or that the claims were accurate.
